set.body: Follow-up to bounded editor/AccessKit task bd-01M62TH3VT280RHSFTZV4Y59VW. Keep actual Japanese/Chinese input-method sessions, VoiceOver reading/navigation/announcements and native pointer drag separate from passing direct NSTextInputClient controls, Unicode paste, AX value/selection/click and Shift-click. Exercise empty/error/disabled fields, mixed bidi/wrapped/scrolling text, IME commit/cancel/focus/external replacement, text-range geometry, word navigation and removal/close with real assistive clients. CUA drag in current validation produced only down/up at its starting point and no native motion; do not count that as a passing drag. Preserve native transcript/evidence and failures; do not change kernel thread/transaction policies or promote bounded macOS JVM results into Native shipping/other-platform/browser parity.
set.title: Qualify real macOS input methods, VoiceOver and pointer drag with AccessKit
